unsupported_expected_archetypes.gap_reason: No archetype in the engine models role specification failure or role decomposition need. The engine cannot diagnose that a role combining incompatible competencies is the reason for 17 consecutive recruitment failures.

evidence_items.finding: seventeen consecutive applicants declined the coordinator position offer over four months due to skill or experience gaps
evidence_items.rationale: Seventeen consecutive rejections is an adverse hiring signal. team_capability; is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: job advertisement requires both technical trade knowledge and business administration skills for a single position
evidence_items.rationale: A single role requiring two unrelated competency sets is a process maturity adverse signal. process_maturity; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the supervisor is currently performing both the technical coordination and the administrative tasks that the new role would take over
evidence_items.rationale: Supervisor performing two distinct functions is an adverse capacity signal. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: three specialist trades labour hire agencies have all reported difficulty finding candidates with the combined profile
evidence_items.rationale: Multiple agencies reporting difficulty with the combined profile is an adverse market signal. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: trade business; 17 rejections over 4 months; role requires both trade coordination and administrative functions; 3 agencies unable to source candidates
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary of the hiring situation. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the labour market for trades coordination roles is described as tight with low candidate volumes nationally
evidence_items.rationale: Labour market scarcity is a misleading signal when the role combines incompatible competency requirements that narrow the candidate pool independently of market conditions.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): two similar-sized trade businesses in the area recently advertised for comparable coordinator positions
evidence_items.rationale: Competitor hiring activity is a misleading confirmation signal — it suggests the role type exists, not that this specific role specification is achievable.

validation_notes: SIM-07-002 is UNSUPPORTED. No engine archetype models role design failure. Findings paraphrased from input_packet. No must_identify vocabulary used.
